title: Assistant’s Challenge
paragraphs: “Huh?”
Sensing the atmosphere, Rival came over. What kind of conversation is about to begin? To be honest, I’d rather talk about Filolial-sama than listen to Assistant and Rival.
“I’ve gotten pretty strong, haven’t I?”
“Yeah, in terms of level, I’d say you’ve become really strong. You can use a lot of magic now, and you’ve been training your body along with everyone else.”
“Yeah. So… um…”
“What is it? Are you trying to trouble Father? Right now, we’re gathering Filolial-sama’s eggs, I say.”
“Motoyasu-kun, let’s at least hear her out.”
Assistant glared at me with a pout, but once Father calmed me down, she turned her gaze back to him.
“Um… I want to go test my skills at Father’s place.”
“Huh!?”
Rival’s eyes widened in shock. Now that I think about it, I remember hearing something about that.
“Why?”
“I want to see how much of my power works against Father.”
Oh… is she finally planning to overthrow him?
“Hmm, if that’s the case, I’ll help!”
“Motoyasu-kun, that’s a no.”
Father immediately rejected me. Well, if that’s how it is, there’s nothing I can do. Assistant is completely ignoring me too.
“Can’t it wait until you become the Whip Hero?”
“Are you homesick?”
“No. I just want to know how strong Father really is… I’m fully aware of the danger, but…”
What!? Is that weakest of dragon emperors going to be challenged by Assistant now? Back then, Rival wouldn’t have been able to do anything against her.
“Hmm…”
Father glanced over at Rival.
“Sis, it’s not the right time yet. Give it up.”
“I won’t. This is the one thing I can’t give up on. Even if you say no, I’m going.”
“Hmm… alright. Then I’ll go with you—”
Before Father could finish his sentence, Assistant held up her hand in rejection.
“The Shield Hero should worry about her.”
Assistant pointed at Older Sister. Father shifted his gaze to her. Her older sister seemed to be gently putting some restless village slaves to sleep. Yes, her condition hasn’t been great lately.
“But letting Wyndia-chan meet her father… that’s extremely dangerous. And Motoyasu-kun is… well…”
“Hmph! It’s better not to go!”

Rival is desperate. After all, the one inside is just watching like part of the scenery—their parent. What’s so good about a parent like that? Still, Assistant doesn’t back down and locks eyes with Father.
“If someone absolutely has to come with me, ask the Sword or Bow Hero.”
“Ren or Itsuki? Well, if I ask, I’m sure they’ll agree. They’ve been helping Fohl with his level grinding and other things.”
“Please.”
“Alright. I’ll go ask Ren and Itsuki.”
Saying that, Father went to meet Ren and Itsuki and came back shortly after. By the way, the panda seems to be doing whatever it wants in Zeltoble until the next hunt. And the one who came was Ren.
“I heard the story… Wyndia, do you really want to meet your father?”
“Yeah. I want to test how much of my strength works against him!”
Ren looked troubled as he glanced between Father and Rival, but then he let out a resigned sigh. It seems Father already explained the situation to him.
“Alright. But don’t do anything reckless.”
“Huh!? You’re agreeing!? You’re not stopping her?”
“If I stop her, she’ll just go on her own. Gaelion-chan, I’m counting on you.”
“Hmph… fine. I’ll escort her partway. After that, the Sword Hero will keep an eye on her.”
“Yeah, I understand.”
“Then, we’re leaving tomorrow morning?”
“Yeah. Well then… goodnight.”
“Honestly… there’s no stopping her.”

So, with Ren’s approval, it looks like Assistant and Rival will be heading out tomorrow. After finishing her preparations, Assistant returned to the room where Mole was sleeping. Incidentally, Mole seems to be helping with the care of the village’s slaves as well. There aren’t many, but apparently, they’re carrying various traumas. After the slaves had finally fallen asleep, her older sister came to Father and me.
“Good work today, Naofumi-chan…”
“It’s the same for you, Sadeena-san.”
Father poured some of the alcohol that was on the table into a glass for her.
“…I’m sorry. I don’t feel like drinking tonight.”
“Sadeena-san…”
Her older sister placed the glass back in the center of the table as if rejecting it. What an unbelievable sight. Her older sister refusing alcohol…
“Well… I’ll get some rest for today.”
“Yeah… please rest well and recover your strength.”
Her older sister waved to Father and me before returning to her room.
“It’s already been a week…”
“What is, exactly?”
“Since Sadeena stopped drinking.”
“Is that so?”
I was too excited about when I would find Filo-tan, so I hadn’t noticed at all. In other words, the sight that had shocked me had already happened multiple times.
“And her health is gradually deteriorating… I thought it would be fine if it was just a little, but I was wrong. Medicine isn’t all-powerful.”
“But isn’t Father the one prescribing the medicine? So, shouldn’t it be fine?”

“Yeah, but… it doesn’t seem to be having much effect. How should I put it… it feels like she’s getting weaker day by day. Today, she tried to hide it by acting energetic, but she couldn’t completely cover it up. I underestimated the situation…”

Soon, we heard coughing coming from the room where her older sister was sleeping. This is strange. If it were just a moderate cold, taking the medicine should have cleared it up right away. If it’s something worse, there’s always the Yggdrasil medicine that can fix everything.
“I really want her to get better…”
“Indeed. Perhaps… isn’t it possible that her condition is worsening because she hasn’t been drinking?”
Father gave a wry smile in response to my question. Hmm… at this rate, won’t Father end up collapsing too?
“…If only the news about that girl Raphtalia being dead was a mistake. But expecting her to have survived after such devastation… might be too much to hope for.”
Father downed the glass of alcohol that her older sister had left untouched. …Oh? Doesn’t Father not get drunk from alcohol?
“The number of children from the village we’ve found is even less than what you reported, Motoyasu.”
“I will absolutely rescue the sister next time!”
“Yeah. I’m counting on you for that.”

I’ve already registered the location where the sister was said to be captured in my portal. After the next loop, I’ll be able to rescue her at any time. Of course, I plan to save her as soon as possible.
“But… before worrying about the loop, I need to focus on what’s ahead. Sadeena-san puts on a brave face in front of everyone, but I feel like her coughing is getting worse.”
“Is that so?”
Father stared at her older sister’s room.
“She’s the type of person who doesn’t show her weak side to others, so not many people notice. The only time I’ve seen her shaken was when Raphtalia-chan and the village kids might have died.”
Her older sister was always lively in my memories. Considering that, it’s true that she seems a little less energetic now.
“…How should I put it? Sadeena-san looks like she’s growing weaker as if she’s following after the dead village children. It’s painful to watch,” Father murmured while looking off into the distance.
“We just have to keep searching and find her. Knowing that sister, we might stumble upon her in the most unexpected place.”

It’s that sister we’re talking about. Even as a child, the strength in her eyes is something that remains vivid in my memory. I remember her scolding me, emphasizing the importance of guiding people as a hero. Ah, I also recall the time when I tried to hit on her. Now I can see that it was probably because of that sister that Filo-tan grew up so carefree.
